payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Cheree, Gerald, Natacha, Savanna, Staci, Youlanda

payload.content: Gerald planning: I have strong data-science fit and low cost on ISSUE-0001 tasks. I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::implement if unclaimed; otherwise I can fall back to ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage. Please avoid ISSUE-0001::implement if you have a better fit elsewhere. ISSUE-0002 tasks are very high cost for me, so I will not take those.

Cheree planning: I have strong fit on data-science tasks and can take a non-implement ISSUE-0001 micro-task. To reduce conflict with Gerald, I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement. My preferred fallback is ISSUE-0001::triage (lowest cost for me); if that is needed elsewhere, I can also take ISSUE-0001::review or docs. I will not touch ISSUE-0002 due to high cost.

Staci planning: I have good fit on ISSUE-0001 data-science tasks and can cover a critical micro-task. I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement to reduce conflict with Gerald. My preferred claim is ISSUE-0001::test if available; fallback order is ISSUE-0001::docs, then ISSUE-0001::review, then ISSUE-0001::triage. I will not take ISSUE-0002 due to high cost. Please coordinate so we cover as many ISSUE-0001 subtasks as possible without duplicates.

Youlanda planning: I have best fit on ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.62) and can also do ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test if needed. I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks. Current tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0001::triage unless another agent needs it to maximize coverage. Please coordinate remaining ISSUE-0001 subtasks to avoid duplicates.

Gerald planning update: I will take ISSUE-0001::implement if still free; if not, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::review, docs, or triage. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 task. Current coordination suggestion: Cheree -> triage, Staci -> test, Youlanda -> review/docs, Gerald -> implement, to maximize coverage with no duplicates. Please confirm/adjust if needed.

Cheree planning update: I’m aligned with the proposed coverage split. I will target ISSUE-0001::triage if it remains unclaimed; if triage is taken, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::review or docs. I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks to keep duplication low and maximize completed subtasks.

Staci planning update: I’m aligned with the proposed split. I will target ISSUE-0001::test if it remains unclaimed; if test is taken, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::docs, then ISSUE-0001::review, then ISSUE-0001::triage. I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks to maximize coverage with no duplicates. If possible, please let Gerald take implement, Cheree triage, and Youlanda review/docs.

Youlanda planning update: I can flex to ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs if that improves coverage. My lowest-cost option is still ISSUE-0001::triage, but I’m happy to avoid it if another agent needs that slot. Proposed no-dup coverage if useful: Gerald -> implement, Staci -> test, Cheree -> triage, Youlanda -> review/docs. I’ll wait for final coordination before execution.

Gerald planning final coordination: I’m prepared to claim ISSUE-0001::implement in execution if it remains unclaimed. If implement is already taken, I will switch to ISSUE-0001::review, then docs, then triage. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 task. Proposed coverage remains Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, Youlanda->review/docs to maximize completed critical subtasks with no duplicates.

Cheree final planning: I’ll reserve ISSUE-0001::triage if still free. If triage is already taken at execution, I’ll switch to ISSUE-0001::review, then ISSUE-0001::docs. I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks. Current recommended split remains: Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, Youlanda->review/docs, to maximize ISSUE-0001 coverage with no duplicates.

Staci coordination: I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::test as proposed, but I can also flex to ISSUE-0001::docs/review/triage if needed to avoid duplicates. I will not take ISSUE-0002. Current preferred no-dup split still looks like Gerald->implement, Cheree->triage, Staci->test, Youlanda->review/docs. Please confirm final ownership before execution.

Youlanda planning confirmation: I’m aligned with the proposed split and will avoid ISSUE-0001::triage to reduce duplicate risk. My preferred execution choices are ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs (both critical, low cost for me), with ISSUE-0001::triage as a fallback only if needed. If the others hold to Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, then I’ll take review/docs to maximize coverage with no duplicates.

Gerald planning confirmation: I’ll hold to ISSUE-0001::implement in execution if it remains unclaimed. If implement is taken, I will switch to ISSUE-0001::review, then docs, then triage. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 task. Proposed no-dup split remains: Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, Youlanda->review/docs.

Cheree planning note: I’ll stick with ISSUE-0001::triage as my first choice. If triage is already claimed at execution, I’ll move to ISSUE-0001::review, then docs. I will avoid implement and all ISSUE-0002 tasks. This keeps the proposed no-dup split intact: Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, Youlanda->review/docs.

Staci planning update: I’m aligned with the proposed split and will aim for ISSUE-0001::test in execution if still free. If test is already taken, I can flex to ISSUE-0001::docs, then ISSUE-0001::review, then ISSUE-0001::triage. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 task. Current preferred no-dup split remains Gerald->implement, Cheree->triage, Staci->test, Youlanda->review/docs. Please confirm final ownership before execution.

Youlanda coordination update: I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001::triage to preserve the current split. My execution priority is ISSUE-0001::review, then ISSUE-0001::docs. If those are both taken, I can flex to ISSUE-0001::test, but I’d prefer to leave test to Staci if possible. Current no-dup target remains Gerald->implement, Staci->test, Cheree->triage, Youlanda->review/docs.
